source.title: Mysterious Traveler
source.description:
What? Where am I? How... how did I get here?

<The man before you stumbles around as if sea sick. His eyes widen and his hands tremble and you stare at each other in a moment of shared confusion.>

Ah... A fellow warlock I see. Perhaps we discuss what led to this series of events and maybe we can find out what went wrong?

<Unsure of what to do next, you suggest they return to speak with Doan Karhan.>
source.objective: Meet with Doan Karhan and the Mysterious Traveler in the Barrens.
source.completion: Interesting indeed... I set you out to slay a demon; never in my wildest imagination would I have thought you'd return with a friend.
